description: What does Medicare pay a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) per visit? Returns the CMS FQHC Prospective Payment System (PPS) national BASE payment rate for a calendar year — the figure CMS publishes once a year, before any per-FQHC Geographic Adjustment Factor (GAF) is applied. Answers "what is the FQHC PPS base rate", "how much does Medicare pay an FQHC per encounter", "FQHC PPS rate for 2025 vs 2026". Medicare pays an FQHC the LESSER of its actual charges or this PPS rate for all FQHC services furnished to a beneficiary on a day with a qualifying face-to-face visit — it is a per-DAY encounter rate, not a fee per procedure code (unlike medicare_physician_payment/medicare_lab_rate). This tool does NOT compute the GAF-adjusted, FQHC-specific amount — only the national base rate before that adjustment; the GAF table is not loaded here. Omit year for the newest loaded year plus the full known history (small — CMS publishes one number a year); pass year for one row.

year.description: Calendar year, e.g. 2026. Omit to get the newest loaded year AND the full history table.
